questionText: I have known her for many years. This time, she took unusual decision in unprejudiced way.
options: I have known her for many years. This time, she took an
I have known her for many years. This time, she took an (alt)
I have known her for many years. This time, she took a
I have known her for many years. This time, she took unusual
explanation:
I have known her for many years. This time, she took an unusual decision in an unprejudiced way. Article 'an' is used before words starting with a vowel sound (an apple, an umbrella, an American). Similarly, in the given sentence, the words 'unusual' and 'unprejudiced' start with a vowel sound. Hence, the sentence given in option(b) is correct.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'I have known her for many years. This time, she took an (alt)' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'I have known her for many years. This time, she took an (alt)' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: My mom made her muffins, but she didn't eat none.
explanation:
she didn't eat any 'None' is not used in a negative sentence. 'None' must be replaced with 'any' as we use 'any' in a negative sentence. Hence, "she didn't eat any" is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'she didn't eat any' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'None' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'any'

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: tide pool is a isolated pocket of water that is formed when
tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when
Tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea
The tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when
explanation:
A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as the tide goes out. Indefinite article 'a/an' is used when we talk about a noun in general. Similarly, the given sentence talks about 'tide pool' and 'isolated pocket' in a general sense. We will use article 'a' before 'tide' (consonant sound) and article 'an' before 'isolated'(vowel sound). Article 'the' will be used before the 2 nd 'tide'. Hence, the sentence given in option(b) is correct.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: He behaves if he were a king.
explanation:
behaves as if 'As if' is used to talk about a situation that may not be true but that is possible. Similarly, in the given sentence, the person may not be a king but he behaves like a king. Hence, 'behaves as if' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'behaves as if' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'behaves as if' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: What do you like to do on your free days other than to watching movies?
explanation:
watching movies We use a noun, pronoun or a gerund(V ing ) after the phrase 'other than'. Therefore, 'to' will be removed. Hence, 'watching(V ing ) movies' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'watching movies' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'watching movies' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: He would be meets us next week.
He would not be met us next week.
He will be meet us next week.
He will be meeting us next week.
explanation:
He will be meeting us next week. The given sentence is in the future continuous tense and follows the structure, "Third person pronoun + will + be + V ing ". Hence, the sentence given in option(d) is correct.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'He will be meeting us next week.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'He will be meeting us next week.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: While I was waiting for Asha for shopping, I spilled lemonade on my new trousers
explanation:
to shop Infinitive(to + V 1 ) is used after the verb 'wait'. Therefore, 'for shopping' must be replaced with 'to shop(V 1 )'. Hence, 'to shop' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'to shop' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'for shopping' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'to shop(V 1 )'

questionText: Whether she wishes to relocate to Mumbai or continues to live here are her personal decisions.
explanation:
is her personal decision 'Whether '… or' is a pair of conjunctions. According to the "Rule of Proximity", the verb is supplied according to the subject closest to the verb. In the given sentence, the close subject is a verb phrase 'continues to live', which denotes a single action. Therefore, singular verb 'is' will be used. Hence, 'is her personal decision' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'is her personal decision' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'is her personal decision' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: He gave his heart and soul to make the entire show a success.
explanation:
Heart and soul- entire energy and effort.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'entire energy and effort' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'entire energy and effort'

questionText: I look forward (see) you soon.
explanation:
to seeing There are some phrases that are always followed by a gerund(V ing ). Such phrases are 'with a view to, looking forward to, in addition to, accustomed to, habituated to, be used to, prone to, etc.' Hence, 'look forward to seeing' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CHSL 2024 Tier - 2

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'to seeing' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'to seeing' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Harish is clever than wise.
explanation:
more clever than When we compare two qualities of the same person, the comparative degree is formed by adding 'more', not by adding '-er'. Hence, 'more clever than' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'more clever than' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'more clever than'

questionText: The firefighters tried their best to extinguish the fire.
explanation:
Put out- to extinguish fire.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।

questionText: Research in Social Sciences is plagued nowadays on gloomy definitions and measurements.
explanation:
nowadays by gloomy definitions 'By' is used in passive voice to indicate the doer or agent of the action. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'by' has been used to indicate the doer of the action 'plagued'. Hence, 'nowadays by gloomy definitions' is the most appropriate answer. SSC MTS 2024 Tier - 1

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'nowadays by gloomy definitions' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'nowadays by gloomy definitions'

questionText: Raghav, who studies tourism at present, is planning to go abroad after his graduation.
explanation:
is studying Present continuous tense is used to indicate an action that is in progress in the present. 'Singular Subject + is + V ing ' is the correct grammatical structure for it. Hence, 'is studying' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'is studying' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'is studying'

questionText: Placing a huge magnet atop the temple pose to being the biggest hurdle for the masons.
explanation:
posed to be 'To + V 1 ', also known as infinitive, is the correct grammatical structure. The given sentence is in the past tense, therefore, the past form(V 2 ) of the verb will be used. Hence, 'posed to be' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'posed to be' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'posed to be' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: One of the most horrified serials of the Indian television industry was broadcast twenty years ago.
explanation:
most horrifying serials 'Horrifying' means causing a feeling of horror. The given sentence states that one of the most horrifying serials of the Indian television industry was broadcast twenty years ago. Hence, 'most horrifying serials' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'most horrifying serials' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'One of / Each of / Either of / Neither of' का प्रयोग अनेक में से किसी एक को चुनने के लिए होता है। अतः इसके बाद Noun/Pronoun हमेशा बहुवचन (Plural) तथा Verb हमेशा एकवचन (Singular) होती है।
  📐 Formula: One of + Definite/Possessive + Plural Noun + Singular Verb.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'most horrifying serials' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Monika said to her mother that, 'I have passed the examination.
options: Monika said to her mother that, "I am passed
Monika said to her mother, "I have passed
Monika said to her mother that, "she has passed
explanation:
Monika said to her mother, "I have passed If the reported speech is given in inverted commas(" " ), it is called direct speech. However, in the direct speech, we do not use any conjunctions ('that', 'if', 'whether') after the reporting verb (say). Therefore, 'that' will be removed from the given sentence. Hence, option(b) is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Monika said to her mother, "I have passed' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'Monika said to her mother, "I have passed' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: If she had gone to the party, she could have met Amit.
explanation:
No substitution required. The given sentence is grammatically correct.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'No substitution required' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'No substitution required' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Heba dropped of the club unexpectedly to say hello and catch up.
explanation:
dropped by the club unexpectedly The phrasal verb 'drop by' means to pay a brief casual visit. The given sentence states that Heba dropped by the club unexpectedly to say hello and catch up. Hence, 'dropped by the club unexpectedly' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'dropped by the club unexpectedly' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'dropped by the club unexpectedly'

questionText: Solving the riddle given by our teacher is farther beyond our capacity.
explanation:
far Positive degree 'far' will be used in this sentence as there is no comparison. Hence, 'far' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Sivamani is workin g as an electrician for the past 22 years.

questionText: She was foolish enough to think that she be completely safe now.

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'is completely safe' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

questionText: No sooner had she finished her breakfast that she had received a phone call from her boss, informing her that she needed to come to work immediately.

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'than she received' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

  📐 Formula: Uncountable Noun (No a/an, No plural -s/-es).

questionText: The train left before I reached the station.

This heritage building is as beautiful as the Red Fort.
This lesser known heritage building is very much beautiful as
This lesser known heritage building is as much beautiful as
explanation:
This lesser known heritage building is as much beautiful as the Red Fort. 'So'…as' is used with 'not' to show that two things are not equal. 'As'…as' or 'As much… as' is used to show that two things are equal in certain respects. According to option(d), the lesser known building and the Red fort are equally beautiful. Hence, option(d) has the correct sentence.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'This lesser known heritage building is as much beautiful as' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'This lesser known heritage building is as much beautiful as'

questionText: If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer. It was the home minister of the country who took the decision to change a laws pertaining to migration of people from one state to another.
explanation:
the laws pertaining Article 'a' must be replaced with 'the'. The 'laws' mentioned in the given sentence are specific and we generally use the definite article 'the' before any specific or particular noun. Hence, 'the laws pertaining' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'the laws pertaining' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'a' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'the'

questionText: One of them contains an error. The underlined parts are given as options with some changes. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error. The film received critical acclaim for being a more innovative movie of the year.
explanation:
An innovative 'More' must be removed as there is no comparison in this sentence. Article 'a' must be replaced with article 'an' as we use 'an' before words starting with a vowel sound (an apple, an umbrella, an MBA). Hence, 'an innovative' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CPO 2023 Tier - 2

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'An innovative' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'An innovative' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: I will definitely return your notes at Saturday .
explanation:
return your notes by Preposition 'by' is used to indicate a deadline or a specific time before which the action will be completed. The given sentence states that the notes will be returned by evening. Hence, 'return your notes by' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'return your notes by' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'return your notes by' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: My sister resembles to my mother a lot in looks and in temperament.
explanation:
resembles The verb 'resembles' does not take the preposition 'to' after it. Hence, 'resembles' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'resembles' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'resembles' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Effective communication is a skill that can significant enhance your personal and professional life.
explanation:
which can significantly enhance The given sentence needs an adverb(significantly) to modify the verb (enhance) and not an adjective (significant). Hence, 'which can significantly enhance' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'which can significantly enhance' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'which can significantly enhance' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: We have received no in form at i on so far to the main island.
explanation:
so far from 'From' is used with 'receive' to indicate the source destination or sender. In the given sentence, 'the main island' is the source destination from which no information has been received so far. Hence, 'so far from' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Uncountable Noun & Article Omission Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'so far from' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Uncountable Nouns (अगणनीय संज्ञाएँ) जैसे Information, Furniture, Advice, Scenery आदि को गिना नहीं जा सकता। अतः इनसे पूर्व 'a/an' का प्रयोग वर्जित है और इनका बहुवचन ('-s/-es') भी नहीं बनाया जाता।
  📐 Formula: Uncountable Noun (No a/an, No plural -s/-es).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'so far from' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: When he was falsely accused of embezzlement, he was beside himself in anger.
explanation:
📘 Grammar Rule: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।

questionText: She is married with a rich business man and has enough money to splurge on luxuries.
explanation:
is married to 'To' is used after the verb 'married' in the passive voice. Hence, 'is married to' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modifier Position (Enough Placement Rule)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'is married to' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Enough' जब Noun की विशेषता बताए (Adjective हो) तो Noun से पहले ('enough experience') आता है। जब Adjective/Adverb की विशेषता बताए (Adverb हो) तो उसके बाद ('tall enough', 'fast enough') आता है।
  📐 Formula: Enough + Noun | Adjective/Adverb + Enough.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'is married to' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Sherpas have prospered and come along the way from being just porters to becoming mountaineers.
explanation:
come a long way The phrase 'come a long way' means to make significant progress or improvement. The given sentence states that Sherpas have prospered and made significant progress from being just porters to becoming mountaineers. Hence, 'come a long way' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'come a long way' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'come a long way'

questionText: You have a lot of coconut trees in your village, do you?
explanation:
don't you? According to the "Question Tag rule", if the statement is positive, the question tag will be negative & Vice-versa. However, the sentence and the question tag must be in the same tense. Similarly, the given sentence is positive so the question tag will be negative(don't). Hence, 'don't you?' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'don't you?' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'don't you?' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: By next summer, I will have completed my internship and will have returned to school.
explanation:
returned to school If two or more verbs are of the same tense then the helping verb is written only once before the first verb. In the given sentence, 'will have' is a helping verb of future perfect tense and has been used for both verbs ('completed' and 'returned'). Hence, 'returned to school' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'returned to school.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'returned to school.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Tomorrow, they will be take a flight to their dream vacation destination.
explanation:
will be taking a flight 'Will be / shall be + V ing ' is the correct grammatical structure of Future continuous tense. Hence, 'will be taking (V ing ) a flight' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'will be taking a flight' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'will be taking a flight' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: As bombs keep falling on Gaza, hundreds of thousands of children have been order to flee their homes.
explanation:
have been ordered to flee 'Subject + has/have + been + V 3 ' is the correct grammatical structure for passive voice of Present perfect tense. 'Ordered' is the correct third form of 'order'. Hence, 'have been ordered(V 3 ) to flee' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'have been ordered to flee' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'have been ordered to flee'

questionText: The pollution level ought to keep under control.
explanation:
ought to be kept under Passive voice is used when the action is performed upon the subject, not by the subject. 'Ought to + be + V 3 ' is the correct passive form. Hence, 'ought to be kept(V 3 ) under' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'ought to be kept' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'ought to be kept'

questionText: This is the challenge task I have ever encountered.
explanation:
most challenging Definite article 'the' is used for a specific or particular thing and before a superlative degree adjective. 'Most challenging' is the correct superlative degree of 'challenging'. Hence, 'most challenging' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'most challenging' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'most challenging'

questionText: Ashoka was not only a great warrior but also a very wiser ruler.
explanation:
wise 'Very' is a positive adverb and takes a positive degree adjective after it. Hence, 'wise' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Subject-Verb Agreement (Nearest Subject in Correlative Conjunctions)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'wise' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Neither...nor', 'Either...or', 'Not only...but also' से जब दो कर्ता जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया (Verb) और सर्वनाम हमेशा अपने निकटतम कर्ता (Nearest Subject) के वचन (Number) व पुरुष (Person) के अनुसार प्रयुक्त होते हैं।
  📐 Formula: Neither + Sub₁ + nor + Sub₂ (Singular/Plural) + Verb (agrees with Sub₂).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'wise' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Cinema provides the most universal entertainment.
explanation:
a universal There are some adjectives that can not be written in comparative or superlative degree. These adjectives are called absolute or non-gradable adjectives. Some examples are universal, absolute, complete, perfect, empty, full, etc. Hence, 'a universal' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'universal' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'universal' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: He is taller and most hand some than his friend.
explanation:
more If two or more adjectives are joined with a conjunction, these adjectives are written in the same degree. In the given sentence, 'and' joins two adjectives, out of which one is comparative degree(taller). Therefore, the second adjective will also be written in comparative degree. 'More handsome' is the correct comparative degree of 'handsome'. Hence, 'more' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CPO 2023 Tier - 1

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'more' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'more' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Lots of kids (was visualise d) crossing the road when the bus arrived.
explanation:
were seen According to the "Subject-Verb Agreement Rule", a singular subject always takes a singular verb and a plural subject always takes a plural verb. In the given sentence, 'lots of kids' is a plural subject that will take 'were' as a plural verb. Hence, 'were seen' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'were seen' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

questionText: Rashmi works at the hospital, don't she?
explanation:
doesn't she? According to the "Subject-Verb Agreement Rule", a singular subject always takes a singular verb and a plural subject always takes a plural verb. questionText: Select the word segment which substitutes the bracketed word correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. I (am here) since 1981.

questionText: This film is a non-stop riot that many cite as one of the funny films of all time.

questionText: Helena loves to dig and played in the dirt like any other child.
explanation:
play in the dirt According to the 'Rule of Parallelism', two or more verbs must be in the same form if they are connected with one another. Hence, 'play in the dirt' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: I used a variety of sources to find the more cheap flight.
explanation:
cheapest We generally use article 'the' with a superlative degree and the correct superlative degree of 'cheap' is 'cheapest'. Hence, 'cheapest' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Parallel Comparison Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'cheapest' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Parallel Comparison (समानांतर तुलना) में जब एक क्रिया में परिवर्तन से दूसरी में भी आनुपातिक बदलाव हो, तो दोनों Comparative Degrees से पूर्व Definite Article 'the' (The + Comparative... The + Comparative...) लगाना अनिवार्य है।
  📐 Formula: The + Comparative Degree + Subject + Verb, the + Comparative Degree + Subject + Verb.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'cheapest' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Brian remained silent during the board meeting, though Rahul was unaware that he had an ace up his sheath the entire time.

The given sentence needs an adverb(especially) and not an adjective(special). Hence, 'small leaks, especially' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Uncountable Noun & Article Omission Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'small leaks, especially' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Uncountable Nouns (अगणनीय संज्ञाएँ) जैसे Information, Furniture, Advice, Scenery आदि को गिना नहीं जा सकता। अतः इनसे पूर्व 'a/an' का प्रयोग वर्जित है और इनका बहुवचन ('-s/-es') भी नहीं बनाया जाता।
  📐 Formula: Uncountable Noun (No a/an, No plural -s/-es).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'small leaks, especially' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Remember to close the windows before you leave.
explanation:
📘 Grammar Rule: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'No improvement' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'No improvement' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: None of the witnessed could identify the suspect.
explanation:
Witness' is a person who sees something happen and who can tell other people about it later. However, the given sentence needs a 'noun' and not a 'verb'. Hence, the verb 'witnessed' must be replaced with the noun 'witness' & 'witnesses could identify' becomes the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'witnesses could identify' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'witnesses could identify' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The early flight is the lest expensive.
explanation:
Superlative degree adjective' denotes the form of an adjective that expresses the highest or a very high degree of quality of a thing, person, etc. For example, best, worst, greatest, most, least, etc. However, we always place the definite article 'the' before any superlative adjective. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'least' is the superlative degree adjective. Hence, 'the least expensive' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Double Negative / Superfluous Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'least expensive' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Forbade', 'Hardly', 'Scarcely', 'Unless', 'Until', 'Lest', 'Prevent' आदि शब्द स्वयं नकारात्मक (Negative) होते हैं। इनके साथ वाक्य में दोबारा 'not' या 'never' का प्रयोग करने से Superfluous (Double Negative) की त्रुटि होती है।
  📐 Formula: Negative Word (Unless / Forbade) + Affirmative Clause (No NOT/NEVER).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'least expensive' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'. None the less, (many an old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, has) kept their romances to the end.
options: many old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, have
many old poets, such Tennyson and Browning, has
many a old poets, such Tennyson and Browning, has
explanation:
According to the " Subject-Verb Agreement Rule ", a singular subject always takes a singular verb and a plural subject always takes a plural verb. In the given sentence, 'poets' is a plural subject that will take 'have' as a plural verb. Hence, 'many old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, have' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'many old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, have' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'many old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, have' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: His shoes were soaked from walk through the dew. Sentence Improvement
explanation:

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'soaked from walking'

questionText: But what of the young people whom are part of the cricket crowds, some of who are presumably born in England?
options: who are part of the cricket crowds, some of who are
whom are part of the cricket crowds, some of whom are
who are part of the cricket crowds, some of whom are
explanation:
If the relative pronoun is followed by a 'verb', then the relative pronoun must be 'who' and if it is followed by a noun or pronoun, then the relative pronoun must be 'whom'. Hence,'who are(verb) part of the cricket crowds, some of whom are presumably born in England' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'who are part of the cricket crowds, some of whom are' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'who are part of the cricket crowds, some of whom are' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

explanation:

questionText: Oscar is the most prestigious award which is introduced to good actors in that year.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

in means of rope ladders they scaled the wall.
Of means of rope ladders they scaled the wall.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
explanation:
Children are fond of sweets. 'Fond of something' means having feelings of affection for something. Similarly, the given sentence states that Children have feelings of affection for sweets. Hence, 'Children are fond of sweets' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Children are fond of sweets.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।

questionText: I am working hard in order to earn a decent living.
explanation:
No substitution. The given sentence is grammatically correct.

questionText: The rate of interest for the loan went out all our calculations.

questionText: Shyama does not laugh, nor she smiles.

questionText: The MNC is about to be bankrupt, according to reliable sources.
explanation:
Go bankrupt' is a phrase that means do not have enough money to pay debt. The given sentence states that the MNC is unable to pay its debts. Hence, 'go bankrupt' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modifier Position (Enough Placement Rule)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'go bankrupt' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Enough' जब Noun की विशेषता बताए (Adjective हो) तो Noun से पहले ('enough experience') आता है। जब Adjective/Adverb की विशेषता बताए (Adverb हो) तो उसके बाद ('tall enough', 'fast enough') आता है।

questionText: Computers and mobile phones have become a necessary and important part of our lives.

questionText: Many companies displaced playing income tax last year.
explanation:
evaded paying. 'Evade' means to manage to escape from or to avoid meeting somebody/something. The given sentence states that many companies did not pay income tax last year. Hence, 'evaded paying' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Past Time Marker & Simple Past Tense Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'evaded paying' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

questionText: Blind by a dust storm, they fell into disorder.
explanation:
Blinded. A participle('ed) is that form of the verb which partakes of the nature of both of a Verb and of an Adjective and a phrase which is introduced by a participle is called a participial phrase. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'blinded' will be the past participle and the phrase that it governs is 'blinded by a dust storm'. Hence, 'Blinded' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Blinded' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: An amateur is a person who takes part in an activity for pleasure.
amateur is a person who takes part in an activity for pleasure.
An amateur is an person who takes part in an activity for pleasure.
Amateur is a person who takes part in a activity for pleasure.
explanation:
We generally use the indefinite article 'a' before the words starting with a consonant sound and article 'an' before words starting with a vowel sound. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'noun', 'person', 'hobby', 'job' are some words that are starting with a consonant sound & 'activity' is the only word that starts with a vowel sound. Hence, 'Amateur' is a noun which refers to a person who takes part in an activity as a hobby or for pleasure and not as a job' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'An amateur is a person who takes part in an activity for pleasure.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'An amateur is a person who takes part in an activity for pleasure.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

Superlative degree adjective' denotes the form of an adjective or adverb that expresses the highest or a very high degree of quality of a thing, person, etc. For example, best, worst, greatest, etc. However, we always place the definite article 'the' before any superlative adjective. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'finest' is the superlative degree adjective. Hence, 'from the finest' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'from the finest' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'from the finest'

questionText: I has no doubts that there is a lesson which stands to be learnt from Alice's misfortune.
options: have no doubt that there is a lesson
have had no doubts that their is a lesson
am having no doubts that there are a lesson
explanation:
We generally use a singular verb with a singular subject. But, 'I' is an exception. The pronoun 'I' is singular but always takes a plural verb in the present tense. For eg- I have a good boy Vishal who helps me. Similarly, in the given sentence, we will use a plural verb(have). Hence, 'I have no doubt that there is a lesson' becomes the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'have no doubt that there is a lesson' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'have no doubt that there is a lesson' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: My sincerity and patience drove me through all odds and problems of life
explanation:
Drove me' means to motivate, compel, or impel one to do something. Whereas, 'carry me' means to escort or accompany someone to a particular place or location. Similarly, the given sentence states that sincerity and patience accompanied the narrator through all odds and problems of life. Hence, ' carried me ' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'carried me' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'carried me'

questionText: The teacher said, " The sun raises in the east every day".
options: the sun will rise in the east
the sun rises in the east
the sun rises at the east
explanation:
The word 'raise' means to elevate something to a higher level/position. However, the word 'rise' means to get up or go to a higher position from a lower position. Similarly, the given sentence states that the sun goes to a higher position from a lower position in the east every day. Hence, 'the sun rises in the east' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'the sun rises in the east' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'the sun rises in the east'

questionText: I was carried by her rapturous song.
explanation:
Carried away' means to be so excited that one is no longer in control of one's behavior as one gets emotionally charged. The given sentence states that the narrator got excited by her rapturous song. Hence, 'carried away' is the most appropriate answer.

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।

questionText: The Ukranian soldiers passed in for several weeks.
explanation:
Held out' means to continue in a situation that is dangerous or difficult. Similarly, the given sentence states that the Ukrainian soldiers continued to be in a difficult situation for several weeks. Hence, 'held out' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'held out' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।

questionText: I told Pooja that she could have use my car to get around while she is in my home town
options: that she could have use my car to get around with
that she can use my car to get around
that she could have use my car to get away
that she can use my car to get away with
explanation:
Either the structure 'have + used(V 3 )' is correct for the given sentence or the modal verb 'can' & the verb 'use' must be in the same present tense. Hence, 'that she can use my car to get around' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'that she can use my car to get around' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'that she can use my car to get around' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Life is hard, unpredictable, but though manageable.
explanation:
There is an adverb error in the given sentence. The adverb 'though' must be replaced with 'still'. Hence, 'still controllable' is the most appropriate answer.

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'still controllable' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'though' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'still'

questionText: Nowadays, many doctors advise to live in the country side.
options: to have live in the countryside
explanation:
The given sentence needs a gerund(V-ing) and not an infinitive(preposition 'to' + V 1 ). Hence, 'living(V-ing) in the countryside' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'living in the countryside' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'living in the countryside'

questionText: It is a bad habit to talk in while someone is speaking.
explanation:

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।

questionText: It was apparent that the girl was heading into a serious disaster.
explanation:

questionText: One must care as for family members as possible.
explanation:

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।

questionText: The delegates talked of the matter for an hour but without any result.

talked over There is a prepositional error in the given sentence. The preposition 'of' must be replaced with 'over' because 'talk over' is the correct phrase that means to discuss something thoroughly. Hence, 'over' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Reena got embarrassed and started crying.
explanation:
The verbs 'em barras ed' & 'crying' must be replaced with 'humiliated' & 'weeping' because they are grammatically more suitable in the context of the sentence. Hence, 'humiliated and started weeping' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'humiliated and started weeping' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'crying' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'humiliated'

questionText: Some politicians turn up their face at the hard life of downtrodden people.
explanation:
Turn up one's nose' is an idiom that means to refuse to take or accept something because it is not good enough. The given sentence states that some politicians refuse to take or accept the hard life of downtrodden people. Hence, 'turn up their nose' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modifier Position (Enough Placement Rule)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'turn up their nose' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Enough' जब Noun की विशेषता बताए (Adjective हो) तो Noun से पहले ('enough experience') आता है। जब Adjective/Adverb की विशेषता बताए (Adverb हो) तो उसके बाद ('tall enough', 'fast enough') आता है।
  📐 Formula: Enough + Noun | Adjective/Adverb + Enough.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'turn up their nose' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: He was bereft of hope after the tragedy struck.
explanation:
Devoid - not having a particular quality

questionText: The organization had set up for a Free Mandela Committee and launched a lively campaign with the slogan 'Free Mandela'.
explanation:

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'had set up' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The minor project put forward by the government is now moving around into its third year.
explanation:
The word around and into has been used together incorrectly. Remove the word around. The correct sentence will be- The minor project put forward by the government is now moving into its third year. So (a) is the most appropriate answer.

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'is now moving into' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: I cannot sit up with this sort of insult in office.
explanation:
Put up with - It is a phrasal verb which means to bear or tolerate something.

questionText: Don't provoke Harsha, otherwise, she will give you a slap.
explanation:
Provoke means to stimulate or arouse some feelings esp anger. Exasperate means to irritate and frustrate (someone) intensely. So option b is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Upon hearing the great achievements of the historic character, he was in a state of awed admiration and respect.
explanation:
A state of awed admiration and respect - wonderment

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'wonderment' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।

questionText: After wearing the complete sports gear, he looked lean, tough, and sinewy.
explanation:
lean, tough, and sinewy - wiry Sinewy is used (of a person or animal) lean and muscular.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'wiry' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'wiry' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Though Mr. Swami ran in debt, he did not stop wasting money.

To 'ran into' means to experience a difficult situation or a problem. In the given question Mr Swami ran into a debt

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'ran into'

questionText: Shanti heard the children who were shouting outside.
options: who were thrashing in the open air
who were flaying in the open air
explanation:

questionText: She walked among me without greeting me.

To 'walk past' means to overcome or overlook something that has happened. For example, you were walking along a street and you saw a man playing flute ahead of you. Similarly in this sentence, she walked past the narrator without greeting him. Hence, 'past me' is the most appropriate answer. (c)

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):

questionText: She is junior than most of her colleagues in the administrative department.

  📐 Formula: Subject + Verb + Superior/Junior/Senior + TO + Object (Never than).

  📐 Formula: Neither + Sub₁ + nor + Sub₂ (Singular/Plural) + Verb (agrees with Sub₂).

questionText: Hardly had I reached the station than the train left.

  📐 Formula: Negative Word (Unless / Forbade) + Affirmative Clause (No NOT/NEVER).

questionText: If you **would have read** the instructions carefully, you would not have answered wrongly.
explanation:

उदा. Conditional sentence के नियम के अनुसार 'If + had + V3' के साथ 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए 'had read' सही है।

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'had read' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house **than it started raining** heavily.
explanation:
'Hardly' and 'Scarcely' are correlative conjunctions always paired with 'when', not 'than/then'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Double Negative / Superfluous Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'when it started raining' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Forbade', 'Hardly', 'Scarcely', 'Unless', 'Until', 'Lest', 'Prevent' आदि शब्द स्वयं नकारात्मक (Negative) होते हैं। इनके साथ वाक्य में दोबारा 'not' या 'never' का प्रयोग करने से Superfluous (Double Negative) की त्रुटि होती है।
  📐 Formula: Negative Word (Unless / Forbade) + Affirmative Clause (No NOT/NEVER).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'when it started raining' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

  📐 Formula: One of + Definite/Possessive + Plural Noun + Singular Verb.

questionText: She is **more taller than** her younger sister.

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'taller'

questionText: He is superior than most of his colleagues in technical skills.
explanation:
Latin comparative adjectives ending in '-ior' (senior, junior, superior, inferior) and 'preferable' are always followed by the preposition 'to', not 'than'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Fixed Preposition Rule (-ior Adjectives take TO)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'superior to' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): '-ior' पर समाप्त होने वाले Comparative Adjectives (superior, inferior, junior, senior, prior, anterior) तथा 'prefer' के बाद 'than' का नहीं बल्कि Fixed Preposition 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Verb + Superior/Junior/Senior + TO + Object (Never than).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'superior to' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house [than it began to rain].
explanation:
'Hardly' and 'Scarcely' are correlative conjunctions always paired with 'when', not 'than/then'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Double Negative / Superfluous Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'when it began to rain' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Forbade', 'Hardly', 'Scarcely', 'Unless', 'Until', 'Lest', 'Prevent' आदि शब्द स्वयं नकारात्मक (Negative) होते हैं। इनके साथ वाक्य में दोबारा 'not' या 'never' का प्रयोग करने से Superfluous (Double Negative) की त्रुटि होती है।
  📐 Formula: Negative Word (Unless / Forbade) + Affirmative Clause (No NOT/NEVER).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'when it began to rain' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: He is superior than me in terms of professional experience.
explanation:

  📐 Formula: Subject + Verb + Superior/Junior/Senior + TO + Object (Never than).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'superior to me' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप
grammarRule: Fixed Preposition with Latin Comparatives (-or adjectives)

questionText: Not only he cheated his friends, but he also deceived his family.
explanation:
For parallel construction with 'not only... but also', 'not only' should be placed immediately before the word it modifies, or inversion can be used on the first clause ('Not only did he cheat'). Here, placing it after the subject ('He not only cheated') makes it parallel with 'he also deceived'.
उदा. 'Not only... but also' में parallelism का नियम लगता है। 'He not only cheated... but he also deceived' सबसे सही और सरल सुधार है।

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'He not only cheated' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'He not only cheated' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप
grammarRule: Parallelism and Placement of Correlative Conjunctions
